notes:
What’s new in 0.1.35:
• Continue Watching shows one row per show — the episode you’re partway through, or the next one once you’ve finished.
• Show names no longer appear twice (like “House” and “house”).
• “Clear all” is now four separate choices: watch history, favourites, watchlist, and watched marks — each shows how many it will remove.
• Install Android 1.21 for Continue Watching that updates live while you watch, Recently added and Because you watched in My Library, and TV game invites.
